name: FF Futurist
summary: FF Futurist is described by Faraday Future's FF EAI Robotics as a full-size professional humanoid robot, offered in a base and an Ultra configuration. The page lists Ultra at $139,990 (169 cm, ≈69 kg, 28 DOF plus a 6-DOF dexterous hand) and a base price from $84,990; FF's newer 'All-New Futurist' is a separate page.
specs_note: OWNER-APPROVED 2026-10-31 (Robert Konecny, in thread, PR #223); unpublished, publication is a separate decision. All values verbatim from https://robotics.ff.com/us/ff-futurist/ (observed 2026-10-31). No specifications are stated in the page markup; all specs null. commercial_status left UNKNOWN: the page offers 'Preorder / Inquire' (recorded as a PREORDER availability offer) but states no status word to map. PRICES RESOLVED 2026-10-31 by reading the rendered page: the page offers two configurations, Futurist (menu 'From $84,990') and Futurist Ultra ($139,990, the only one with a spec column), recorded as variants. The earlier 34,990 USD figure came from the page's JSON-LD markup and is NOT recorded as an offer: it matches the 'FF Master Ultra — From $34,990' menu entry and conflicts with every on-page Futurist price. The page banner says 'FF New Futurist - Coming Soon on 6/22'; FF's current page https://robotics.ff.com/us/futurist/ sells a different 'FF All-New Futurist' (separate identity draft ff-all-new-futurist, not merged). commercial_status ANNOUNCED set by the owner 2026-10-31.
